events.title: Transition Assistance Workshop
events.description: SEP 21 – 23 | 8 am – 4 pm This 3-day Congressionally mandated program, which includes VA benefits and Employment Fundamentals, is designed to prepare military members and their families for their transition to the civilian sector. M&FRC 228.376.8728

events.title: Survivor Benefit
events.description: SEP 21 | 3 -4 pm Sablich Center | Room 108A Briefing to advise retiring service members and their spouses on the survivor benefit program to assist in making an informed decision before retirement on benefits. M&FRC 228.376.8728

events.title: Facet Frenzy Sale
events.description: SEP 1 – 30 Arts & Crafts Center Discover the Facet Frenzy Bisque Sale at the Arts & Crafts Center! Whether you’re a seasoned artist or just looking for a creative escape, this is the perfect opportunity to add some modern flair to your collection. Please note: paint and studio fees are additional. events.description: AUG 5 – SEP 26 | Season Youth Center Step up to the plate and join our Youth Baseball League! This program is designed for kids ages 3–12 and is the perfect opportunity for young players to learn the fundamentals of baseball, make new friends, and have fun in a supportive team environment. Practices are on Wednesday and games are played on Saturdays Sign up on CYPBMS. Call the Youth Center at 228.377.4116 Open to all with base access and sponsored guests Ages | 3 – 12 $50 Ages 3 – 4 | $ 60 | Ages 5 – 12

If you’re interested in coaching or assisting this season, this is your chance to get involved, meet fellow coaches, and learn everything you need to know for a successful season. Butterflies, symbols of transformation and hope, will be released in the serene setting of the Fallen Heroes Butterfly Garden. This special ceremony invites everyone in attendance to take part in a collective tribute—each guest will have the opportunity to release a butterfly in remembrance and gratitude. Let us gather to celebrate the enduring legacy of our heroes and embrace the beauty of r

Teams will be formed one week before the start date, giving everyone a chance to meet their teammates and get ready for the season. events.title: Crabbing Class
events.description: SEP 27 | 10 am Keesler Marina Join our Crabbing Class at Keesler Marina and learn how to catch the beloved blue crab! Surrounded by the beautiful waters of the marina, you’ll receive hands-on instruction in the basics of recreational crabbing. Each participant will receive one crab ring and bait, making it easy for beginners and fun for all ages. Discover the secrets of successful crabbing and enjoy a memorable day on the water. Open to all with base access and sponsored guests Ages | 5+ $15 | Per Person Register by September 24 Outdoor Recreation 228.377.3160

Whether you’re a car enthusiast or just looking for a fun morning out, Cruisin’ Keesler has something for everyone—don’t miss it! Open to all with base access and sponsored guests. sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring your PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry copies of all travel vouchers and receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival. Visit the Military Personnel Section within 24 duty hours. Your unit will schedule additional in-processing appointments.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Office before arrival. On-base housing is managed by Balfour Beatty Communities. Temporary lodging is available through the Lodging Office.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival and assist with base orientation. Contact your gaining unit if no sponsor is assigned before you depart.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official newcomers information, family programs, and community support services. See Military OneSource, Military.com, and BaseDirectory for additional relocation resources.
